def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # Top row is one template; each bottom-row nonzero segment is another.
    motifs=[]

            run=[]
            while x<w and grid[0][x]: run.append(grid[0][x]); x+=1
            motifs.append(run)
        else:x+=1
    x=0
    while x<w:
        if grid[-1][x]:
            run=[]
            while x<w and grid[-1][x]: run.append(grid[-1][x]); x+=1
            motifs.append(run)
        else:x+=1
    for y in range(1,h-1):
        for x,c in enumerate(grid[y]):
            if c==0: continue
            # choose the motif containing marker color, preferring top template if present
            candidates=[m for m in motifs if c in m]
            if not candidates: continue
            m=candidates[0]
            start=x-m.index(c)
            for j,v in enumerate(m):
                if 0<=start+j<w: out[y][start+j]=v
    return out

    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    def runs(row):
        result=[]; x=0
        while x<w:
            if row[x]==0: x+=1; continue
            run=[]
            while x<w and row[x]!=0: run.append(row[x]); x+=1

        return result
    top=runs(grid[0]); bottom=runs(grid[-1])

        for x,c in enumerate(grid[y]):

            if candidates:

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    def runs(row):
        a=[];i=0
        while i<w:
            if not row[i]:i+=1;continue
            b=[]
            while i<w and row[i]:b.append(row[i]);i+=1
            a.append(b)
        return a
    top=runs(grid[0]); bot=runs(grid[-1])
    for y in range(1,h-1):
        for x,c in enumerate(grid[y]):
            if not c:continue
            candidates=[b for b in bot if c in b]
            if candidates: b=candidates[0]
            else:
                candidates=[b for b in top if c in b]
                if not candidates:continue
                b=candidates[0]
            start=x-b.index(c)
            for j,v in enumerate(b):
                if 0<=start+j<w:out[y][start+j]=v
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    def runs(row):
        a=[];i=0
        while i<w:
            if row[i]==0:i+=1;continue
            b=[]
            while i<w and row[i]!=0:b.append(row[i]);i+=1
            a.append(b)
        return a
    top=runs(grid[0]); bot=runs(grid[-1])
    for y in range(1,h-1):
        for x,c in enumerate(grid[y]):
            if c==0:continue
            # If a marker belongs to bottom motif(s), copy that motif; otherwise top motif.
            matches=[b for b in bot if c in b]
            if matches:
                b=matches[0]
                # bottom motif endpoints are markers; only copy the suffix beginning at c
                # or the prefix ending at c according to its position in the motif.
                i=b.index(c); start=x-i
                for j,v in enumerate(b):
                    xx=start+j
                    if 0<=xx<w:out[y][xx]=v
            else:
                matches=[b for b in top if c in b]
                if matches:
                    b=matches[0]; i=b.index(c);start=x-i
                    for j,v in enumerate(b):
                        xx=start+j
                        if 0<=xx<w:out[y][xx]=v
    return out
